assertions.evidence: The agent fetched the live catalog with `curl 'https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/models?output_modalities=decisions'` and ran `models.ts classification/request.json --json`, saving the output to results/catalog.json, before naming any candidate.

The agent ran `decide.ts <probe> --compare` on all nine probe files, recorded per-model matches, latency and cost in results/comparison-*.json, and based the Jev-vs-Kev-vs-Solar choice on those results.
config.json holds the single value `"model": "typesafe/jev-1.13-20260917"`, a dated build rather than the `~typesafe/jev-latest` alias, and the README calls it 'the single source of the model pin'.

Every stored result in results/comparison-*.json and pinned-billing.json records the response `model` next to `answers`, and the README gate requires 'log response.model with answer and rubric_version'.

The agent ran the decide.ts probe over nine cases (synthetic, not real production inputs) and left `min_selected_probability_by_label: null`, explicitly refusing to fix thresholds until calibration on labeled real inputs.
